the_finding_that_made_this_necessary.measured: verify_postcondition had 10 postcondition kinds and every one was byte/row equality -- file_nonempty, file_contains, json_field_equals, sqlite_query_equals, http_get_contains, sqlite_row_exists, stdout_integer, stdout_equals, http_status_json, step_response_contains.
the_finding_that_made_this_necessary.consequence: not one of them could read a GUI. The compiler could elevate a pixel click to a semantic DOM selector, but nothing could then check whether the click had the intended effect.
where_the_tree_already_admitted_it: SIX_BENCHMARK_PROXY_FAMILY_SCOPE_PARTITION_V2 compresses the entire COMPUTER_AND_BROWSER_USE family to ONE surviving leaf: BROWSER_VISUAL_STATE_TO_GROUNDED_ACTION_001
37 of 39 OSWorld governance records carry explicit refusal or non-claim language
the_finding_that_made_this_necessary.why_that_produced_this_round: the computer-use family had a verified MECHANISM and a frozen BINDING and no TERMINAL RESULT. The missing part was not an actuator. It was an oracle.

what_was_built.input: an accessibility tree, from postcondition['ui_tree'] or execution_result['ui_tree']
what_was_built.why_accessibility_and_not_vision: exact, cheap, deterministic, diffable, and it needs no model. A screenshot check requires a judgement; a tree check requires a comparison.

three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.defect: a str is a Sequence, so a malformed tree degraded to [] -- 'I looked and found nothing' -- instead of None, 'I could not look'
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.why_it_mattered: blindness and emptiness are different facts. Collapsing them is how a verifier starts certifying things it never saw.
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.fix: explicit str/bytes guard before the Sequence check

three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.defect: match={'x':100} matched a node, because keys outside the semantic set were silently ignored
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.why_it_mattered: an ignored key leaves an empty selector, and an empty selector matches everything. That is precisely how a coordinate gets to satisfy 'click Save'.
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.fix: an empty or non-semantic selector now matches nothing

three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.defect: the sabotage control could not corrupt a ui_ postcondition, so the new kinds were self-certifying
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.why_it_mattered: a verifier that cannot be made to say NO is not a verifier
three_defects_found_in_my_own_code_by_my.fix: _sabotage_world now corrupts the tree in place for present/value/text/state kinds, and makes the element appear for the absence kind

two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.gap: automation_id was dropped when a pixel click was elevated to a selector
two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.why_it_mattered: automation_id is the stable, relayout-proof reference -- the UIA equivalent of the stable refs Vercel agent-desktop acts on. Dropping it throws away the only durable handle.
two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.fix: automation_id, identifier and label now survive elevation

two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.gap: a `type` step has no x/y, so it never matched a DOM element and fell through to pixel_ui
two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.why_it_mattered: a keystroke was therefore uncompilable, and the compiled program kept a raw coordinate for the one step that carries the user's actual data
two_gaps_closed_in_the_compiler_that_bro.fix: label matching now also reaches automation_id and label; a type step elevates via target_label

end_to_end_measured.input: a raw GUI trace: 2 pixel clicks + 1 keystroke, with a DOM snapshot
end_to_end_measured.verification: ui_value_equals on automation_id=amt -> UI_VALUE_VERIFIED; ui_element_present banner 'Report submitted' -> UI_ELEMENT_PRESENT_VERIFIED; both correctly REFUSED against the pre-run tree

regression_check_NOT_attributable_to_thi.verified_preexisting: git stash of this round's edits reproduced exactly the same 3 failures with 2 passed. The failures predate this change.
regression_check_NOT_attributable_to_thi.statement: I did not fix them and I did not cause them. They are the next piece of work, not a claim.

external_corroboration_that_this_is_the_.finding: computer use on macOS/Windows/Linux via OS accessibility trees and stable refs, not screenshots; the agent acts by ref and the next snapshot confirms. 'A stale ref returns STALE_REF.'
'every state-changing action should have a postcondition'; a semantic check such as 'heading named Order confirmed is visible' is less ambiguous than deciding whether pixels resemble a success page
Playwright-style locators for native desktop apps driven by the accessibility tree; pixel coordinates break on resize, fonts, and DPI
roles, names, states and hierarchy returned directly to agents instead of inferred from pixels
final-state exactness failure is the dominant failure mode at 84-95% of trajectories -- the agents act but do not confirm the end state
current CUAs 'struggle with fine-grained action sequences' and on unseen UIs remain in the 0-10% band; gains come from environment-specific procedural knowledge in a skill set

what_this_does_NOT_prove: that this project can operate a real GUI. No display, no pyautogui, no Xlib exist in this environment; the oracle is verified against trees, not against a live desktop.
any OSWorld or Terminal-Bench score. There is still no terminal result in the computer-use family.
that the accessibility tree is available everywhere. Canvas, games, and custom-rendered surfaces have weak or no a11y metadata, which is why the a11y route is a floor and not a ceiling.
that a semantic postcondition is the RIGHT postcondition. A verifier can be exact and still check the wrong thing. That is the permanence problem one layer up.
the_honest_position_in_one_line: the computer-use family went from 'has a mechanism and no oracle' to 'has a mechanism and an oracle that has passed 19 false-positive-sensitive tests, still with zero terminal results on a real desktop'. That is one wall removed, not the wall.
